title: Rep. David J. Taylor Disclosed 3 Trades: Marathon Petroleum Sale, Home Depot and Amgen Buys (Oct 1)
content:
Rep. David J. Taylor (OH-02) disclosed three trades on October 1, 2026, all dated September 22: a sale of Marathon Petroleum (MPC) and purchases of Home Depot (HD) and Amgen (AMGN).

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

TickerCompanyType / sizePrice at trade vs. Oct 2 (Bargo est.)
MPCMarathon Petroleum CorporationSale, $1,001–$15,000$389.68 vs. $422.33 (+8.38%)
HDHome Depot, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$305.35 vs. $282.85 (−7.37%)
AMGNAmgen Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$410.24 vs. $403.04 (−1.76%)

Transaction date for all three: Sep 22, 2026. Disclosure date: Oct 1, 2026 (9 days later). Member: Rep. David J. Taylor, OH-02 (House).

What's been disclosed

  • One sale: Marathon Petroleum, $1,001–$15,000, on September 22.
  • Two purchases: Home Depot and Amgen, each $1,001–$15,000, on September 22.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Marathon Petroleum about 8.4% higher on October 2 than on the sale date, Home Depot about 7.4% lower and Amgen about 1.8% lower than on the purchase date.
  • Row count: Bargo's data lists 5 rows for this filing. Two rows (Marathon Petroleum and Home Depot) are exact repeats, which leaves the 3 distinct trades shown above.

Quick FAQ

Why does the post say 3 trades when the data has 5 rows?
Two rows are exact copies of another row. The data does not show whether they are duplicate entries or separate transactions with identical details, so we count the 3 distinct trades.

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
9 days. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $1,001–$15,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the October 2 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.

Trade data from Bargo (STOCK Act filings). This post is our own summary of public filings and is not investment advice. See our Disclaimer and evidence labels.
